'''Hemlock's shuttle''' was a [[Rho-class transport shuttle|''Rho''-class transport shuttle]] that [[transport]]ed [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]] to the [[Imperial summit on Eriadu]]<ref name="The Summit" /> during or after [[18 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> After a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] arrived above [[Eriadu]], Hemlock's [[shuttle]] was escorted by three [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]] to [[Raven's Peak|Tarkin's Compound]] for the summit. Unbeknownst to Hemlock, [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] and everyone else in the compound, [[Clone Force 99]] [[Bombing of Raven's Peak|infiltrated]] the heavily fortified facility, so they could plant a [[homing beacon]] on the shuttle, in hopes of tracking the ship to its [[Tantiss Base|base]] and rescue their brother [[Crosshair]]. Simultaneously, [[Saw Gerrera]] and the [[Partisans]] also infiltrated the compound with the desire to destroy the compound and [[Death|kill]] all the Imperials stationed there. After evading several [[TK stormtrooper]]s, [[Omega]] successfully installed the homing beacon on Hemlock's shuttle. However, the [[Cloning|clones]] were later forced to flee the compound via the [[Raven's Peak sky train]]. The shuttle was soon destroyed along with all the other shuttles in the [[hangar]], when Gerrera detonated several [[thermal explosive]]s.<ref name="The Summit" />

Hemlock's shuttle was [[Color|gray]] and unlike most ''Rho''-class transport shuttles, it lacked the ventral cargo pod.<ref name="The Summit" />
